templates_editor_block_placeholder: Write the block's content in markdown…
templates_editor_tags_empty: This project has no tags yet.
templates_error_attachments_not_allowed: Blocks and templates can't contain attachments yet. Remove the attachment and try again.
templates_error_block_invalid_type: The block on line {line} has an invalid type. Use lowercase kebab-case, such as acceptance-criteria.
templates_error_block_malformed_open: Line {line} isn't a valid block opener. Write <block type="key"> or <block type="key" sync>.
templates_error_block_nested: The block on line {line} opens inside another block, and blocks can't nest.
templates_error_block_stray_close: Line {line} closes a block that was never opened.
templates_error_block_unclosed: The block opened on line {line} is never closed.
templates_error_blocks_not_allowed: A block can't contain other blocks.
templates_error_invalid_blocks: The block markup on line {line} isn't valid.
templates_error_key_taken: That key is already used here. Pick another key.
templates_new_example_note: Sections the example uses are added if they don't exist yet. You can change everything afterwards.
templates_new_section_for_type: It's added to {name} when you create it. Write its text afterwards with Edit.
templates_sections_changed_body: Tickets in {project} get this version, not the shared one. Edits to the shared version don't show up here.
templates_sections_content_heading: What it puts in a ticket
templates_sections_group_own_empty: No sections of its own yet.
templates_sections_hidden_body: Ticket types in {project} leave this section out, and it can't be added to a ticket there.
templates_sections_hint_help: Grey text is a hint: it shows in an empty ticket and is never saved.
templates_sections_notice_org_admins: Only organization admins can change sections.
templates_sections_notice_project_manage: Only project managers can change sections.
templates_sections_org_changed_body: Projects here get this version, not the built-in one. Updates to the built-in section don't show up here.
templates_sections_org_note: Editing a section here changes it in every project that uses it as is. For a section that is the same on every ticket, existing tickets change too.
templates_sections_same_off: Off: each ticket gets its own copy to edit, and a change here applies to new tickets only. Turn it on to lock the text, for example for a definition of done.
templates_sections_same_on: Locked: every ticket shows this text exactly as written here, and nobody can edit it in a ticket. Checkboxes can still be ticked. A change here reaches existing tickets too.
templates_sections_used_by_none: No type starts with it yet.
templates_settings_entry_missing: This entry doesn't exist here anymore.
templates_settings_key_invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
templates_settings_key_reserved: That key is reserved. Pick another one.
templates_starts_teaser: Templates fill a ticket in with structure, priority and tags.
templates_types_builtin_body: To change it, make a custom version for this organization. Every project then uses that version.
templates_types_changed_body: New {name} tickets in {project} start from this version, not the shared one. Edits to the shared version don't show up here.
templates_types_delete_stopped: Moved {moved} tickets, then stopped. {name} wasn't deleted. {reason}
templates_types_delete_unused: No tickets in {project} have this type.
templates_types_delete_used: {count} tickets in {project} have the type {name}. Choose what they become. Their descriptions don't change.
templates_types_delete_used_one: 1 ticket in {project} has the type {name}. Choose what it becomes. Its description doesn't change.
templates_types_fork_org: Make a custom version for this organization
templates_types_group_own_empty: No types of its own yet.
templates_types_group_shared_note_switch: Every project has these. Switch one off to leave it out of {project}.
templates_types_hidden_body: New tickets in {project} can't use it. Tickets that already have it keep it.
templates_types_notice_all_projects: Only organization admins can edit it for the organization.
templates_types_notice_org_admins: Only organization admins can change ticket types.
templates_types_notice_project_managers: Only project managers can change ticket types.
templates_types_org_changed_body: Projects here get this version of {name}, not the built-in one. Updates to the built-in {name} don't show up here.
templates_types_org_changed_title: This organization has a custom version.
templates_types_org_note: Editing a type here changes it in every project that uses it as is. A project that changed a type keeps its custom version.
templates_types_reorder_aria: Move {name}. Use the up and down arrow keys.
templates_types_revert_org: Go back to the built-in version
templates_types_revert_project: Go back to the shared version
templates_types_section_missing: This section doesn't exist here anymore.
templates_types_shared_body: It's shared by every project in this organization. To change it, make a custom version for {project} or edit it for the organization.
templates_types_shared_body_fork_only: It's shared by every project in this organization. To change it, make a custom version for {project}.
templates_types_shared_body_read_only: It's shared by every project in this organization.
templates_types_starts_empty: Nothing yet. A new ticket of this type starts empty.
templates_types_starts_note: Applies to new tickets. Existing tickets keep their text, except sections that are the same on every ticket.
templates_types_tab_sections_intro: A section is a named part of a ticket's description, such as Acceptance criteria or Steps to reproduce. Ticket types are made of sections, and you can add a section to any ticket.
templates_types_tab_types_intro: A ticket type is the kind of work a ticket is, such as Bug or Feature. The type decides which sections a new ticket starts with, and can set its priority and tags.
templates_types_use_section_off: {name} is off in {project}. Switch it on to use it again.
templates_types_use_section_on: {name} is on in {project}. Switch it off and ticket types there leave it out.
templates_types_use_type_off: {name} is off in {project}. Switch it on to use it for new tickets.
templates_types_use_type_on: {name} is on in {project}. Switch it off and new tickets there can't use it. Tickets that already have it keep it.
templates_types_usage_all_one: As is in the only project
templates_types_usage_too_many: Use per project shows for up to {count} projects.
